parameters.formDescription: Step 1 of 3. Say where the copy is and where the files go. Next you choose the project and the templates.

values.placeholder: Campaign id or name from the sheet (leave empty for all rows)
e.g. en, de, fr (leave empty for all languages)

parameters.formDescription: Step 2 of 3. The projects linked in Creatives. The default project is listed first.
parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ fieldLabel: 'Project', fieldType: 'dropdown', requiredField: true, fieldOptions: { values: [...$json.projects].sort((a, b) => Number(b.default) - Number(a.default)).map((p) => ({ option: p.name })) } }]) }}

parameters.formDescription: Step 3 of 3. Every template and aspect ratio in the project (template/ratio). Pick as many as you need.
parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ fieldLabel: 'Creatives', fieldType: 'dropdown', multiselect: true, requiredField: true, fieldOptions: { values: Object.entries($json.templates).flatMap(([template, ratios]) => Object.keys(ratios).map((ratio) => ({ option: template + '/' + ratio }))) } }]) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ projectId: $json.projectId, template: $json.template, ratio: $json.ratio, data: $json.data, format: 'png', scale: 1 }) }}
